date.as_written: samvat 823 āśvinamāse śuklapakṣe, paṃcamyāṃ tithau jyeṣṭhanakṣatre (!) śo(9)bhanayoge somavāra

notes: The Newari phrase 'śrīśrīhemantamallanathamacosyaṃ sidhayakā dina juroṃ' resolves to 'śrīśrī-Hemantamalla-na thama cosyaṃ sidhayakā dina juroṃ' (the day on which Śrī Śrī Hemantamalla himself completed writing [it]).
